name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PublicSlices.universal_commutant
title: Universal commutant masking needs cyclic coverage and equivariant splittings
statement: Under the action-closure axioms, every source subspace has a commuting shift fixing it with image in any annihilator containing its slice image exactly when slice reach equals action reach and all invariant subspaces admit equivariant retractions.
